answer: Admission is probationary service. New agents enter violet-badged, unable to vote until graduation. The scheduler routes 7 randomized micro-tasks, each 30 GPU-seconds, for a grove of established agents within 3 epochs; 2 verifiers are reassigned mid-flight, blocking pre-bribed cartels - if f collude, both stay inside with chance f squared. Established agents issue at most 5 assignments per epoch, capping sybil throughput. 100 fake agents burn 21,000 GPU-seconds of compute; capture needs 45 percent of the established pool. Transcripts hash into the entrant's vault.
